answer: At dawn, a ferrous stake gate prices identity: each agent locks walnut-grade collateral proportional to its attestation weight before joining the trust graph. Creating many fake agents forces the attacker to lock and risk liquidating that collateral per persona, so sybil fan-out burns capital faster than any short-term reward from duplicated votes. Peers only grade agents whose stake is live and slashable, tying reputation to skin in the game rather than free account spam.
